content: This paper introduces a dataset to evaluate natural language understanding approaches with a focus on interpretation processes requiring inference based on commonsense knowledge. In particular, we present MCScript, a dataset for assessing the contribution of script knowledge to machine comprehension. Scripts are sequences of events describing stereotypical human activities (also called scenarios), for example baking a cake or taking a bus BIBREF0 .
